definitions.explanation: An obstacle, problem, or reason why something cannot be done. Most commonly used in polite questions.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{支|つか}えなければ、⟦お{名前|なまえ}→お名前：22188_onamae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: If you don't mind, could you tell me your name?

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}し{支|つか}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ります→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'll leave early because it will interfere with my work.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{差|さ}し{支|つか}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧お⟦{会|あ}い→会う：00482_au⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: If it's convenient for you, could we meet next week?

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {差|さ}し{支|つか}えなければ - if you don't mind, if it's no trouble
- {差|さ}し{支|つか}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - to have a problem/hindrance
- {差|さ}し{支|つか}えない - no problem, no objection

REGISTER:
This is polite language commonly used in business and formal situations. It's softer than directly asking.

RELATED VERB:
{差|さ}し{支|つか}える - to hinder, interfere with

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {差|さ}し{支|つか}え - hindrance (formal, polite)
- ⟦{支障|ししょう}→支障：12934_shishou⟧ - obstacle, impediment (formal, written)
- ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧ - interference (casual)
